Twenty-two comments

Another Tom Billy’s?

I heard this from a De Dannan tape years back. The combined this winner with Ryan’s Jig. I wouldn’t say that it’s for begginers but it is none the less a great piece to learn.

I enjoy nice quiet rolls in the A part then a regular voice to the remaining notes. No need to rush this one. The tune will get lost with real quick if ya don’t take some time.

Mark

↳ Posted by Mark Cordova on June 28th, 2002.

Tom Billy’s, X:8

Taken from ‘A Fine Selection of Over 200 Irish Traditional Tunes for Sessions’, compiled by David Speers with a Forward by Matt Cranitch. This appears in G mixolydian and with the parts in this order. All the tunes in this book were collected in the 1980’s and 90’s at fleadhanna in Ireland, so it’s possible the order of the parts was mistaken.
